name: Learielaw BESS, near Broxburn
how: Facts copied from the documents in this folder. Each was matched by script to the words on the page cited. 'must' = on the site, next to it, or within 5 km; 'should' = further out or position not stated; 'none_expected' = the document says there are none within distance_km.
distance_basis: As stated in the document: usually from the site boundary, sometimes from the nearest turbine (see note).
notes: A small site (your polygon is 7 ha), so on-site and near-site facts are the whole story.
Union Canal: about 280 m in the determination letter, about 300 m in the supporting document.
The letter's directions read oddly ('1 km south of Broxburn', '7 km southwest of Edinburgh Airport'); they describe where the site is, so Broxburn is to the north and the airport to the north-east.
